I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm I'd noted that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261 seats. I told them I hadn't checked that number against any contract or order form, so it stands as their figure.

That's all I did, since they said no action was needed. A seat count counts as operational account information rather than a finance figure, so it's fine to have it in that channel.
